docs.body:
ParallaxDB tuning guide.

Page size is chosen when the database file is created and cannot be changed afterwards. The default page_size is 4096 bytes, which suits spinning disks.

For flash storage, the recommended page_size is 16384 bytes: flash pages align better, and scan throughput improves measurably on large files.

Cache sizing: give the cache about a quarter of RAM. Write-ahead log: leave sync on for anything you would mind losing.
docs.snippet: Tuning ParallaxDB: page size, cache sizing, and write-ahead log settings for flash and spinning disks.
